summary: KNOREX Ltd. filed a Form 6-K updating the effective date of resignations of Non-Executive Independent Directors Jayant Kadambi and Gordon Kwok Wai Lam. The board waived the 30-day contractual notice period, making resignations effective immediately after a board meeting on 9 June 2026 (SGT). No terms are specified beyond the immediate departure. The change represents an abrupt board departure without routine succession. File maps as a foreign private issuer equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure. Watch for potential leadership instability or governance impact.
